review.why: Writes copy-paste-ready posts for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and Reddit with each platform's limits, hooks and image sizes.
review.summary: Works from a topic, from existing content or as a coordinated campaign. For each of four platforms it gives audience, tone, length, structure, rules and a worked example, plus image specs, an output layout and a launch posting sequence. Quality rules forbid pasting one text everywhere and faking engagement.
strengths: A rule set and a worked example for every platform
Reddit guidance: lead with value, check subreddit rules, no marketing feel
Local-only tools: reads and writes files, no network
cautions: Hashtag counts and link-reach claims are rules of thumb
All examples come from one product-launch story
